text: ITEM 1 | Two thin, flat, reddish-brown strips with a glossy, slightly translucent sheen and a dry-looking surface; edges are ragged and frilled with small jagged serrations, one strip about 14 cm long and 2 cm wide, the other about 10 cm long and 1.5 cm wide with a tapered tail; they lie crossed over each other on a white square plate, with faint orange-tinged residue smears nearby | 25
